channel.title: The Heartbeat Framework — Developments
channel.description: A dated, permanent record of developments on the estate: publications, external events the framework interlocks with, and releases.

item.title: What the Signature Certifies: the consultation paper is published as record twenty.
item.description: NHS England is revising DCB0129 and DCB0160. The companion paper to the author’s consultation response is now open access: four asks, with the requirement-level drafting to implement them.

item.title: DSIT publishes an AI Risk Management Toolkit. It measures the machine, not the room.
item.description: The Department for Science, Innovation and Technology has released a risk toolkit for public-sector AI. Nine categories, all capability-side. Where the estate supplies the missing culture term.

item.title: The National Commission reports. Where the estate meets it.
item.description: The MHRA-hosted National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare has published its recommendations. Six of them describe gaps this estate already carries instruments for.

item.title: The Tenant’s Record published as record nineteen.
item.description: A working paper on tenancy and ownership: who the system serves when the system is not yours. Published open access, with a new Sovereignty page on the estate to carry the doctrine.

item.title: The Instrument Deck: all eight instruments in deployment order.
item.description: A single 38-page deck consolidating the estate’s eight instruments — Gate, Screen, Specify, Oversee, Trial, Audit, Measure, Record — in the sequence they are meant to be run.
